newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee ends steady vs spot dlr, up in forward.
newsitem.headline: India rupee ends steady vs spot dlr, up in forward.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended Monday at 35.84/85 per dollar after a day of range-bound trade, little changed from the weekend close of 35.840/845, dealers said.
Dealers said the rupee traded at a high of 35.82 and a low of 35.845 on Monday.

"The rupee was mostly stuck in a narrow range between 35.83 and 35.84 for much of the day," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Some late dollar buying by the State Bank of India pushed the rupee down toward close."
Dealers said the Reserve Bank of India bought dollars in small amounts between 35.825 and 35.835.
Forward premiums opened down and remained easy through the day, dealers said. They said expectations of easy liquidity strengthened the rupee against the forward dollar.
"Exporter sales of forward dollars, light covering by importers..this sums up the market at the moment," said a dealer.
The annualised premium for six-month dollars ended Monday at 4.52 percent against the weekend close of 4.74 percent.
